vadsrijk.karakter.modus.normaal.uitleg: The normal adventure. Fainting costs nothing: you wake up at your last campfire.
vadsrijk.karakter.modus.eenvads.uitleg: One life! Faint outside a town and your knight retires: a statue in the Rustende Ridders hall in Zwamzoet, where they rest for good (you don't play them any more). Then the right slot can make a new One-Vads knight. While alive: a gold heart by your name and 10% more xp.
vadsrijk.karakter.modus.knuffel.uitleg: Play the story at ease: monsters only do half their damage to you. You do get 10% less xp. A pink cloud by your name.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.uitleg: Every knight has their own levels, gear, quests and Vadsmunten. Clothes, mounts, pets and the bank are shared.
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.plek: You can only switch knights in a town or at a campfire.
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.arena: Not in the middle of a boss fight!
vadsrijk.karakter.niet.scene: Wait until the cutscene is over.
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.slot: That slot can't be used (taken or empty).
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.naam: Give your knight a name (letters and digits, max 16).
vadsrijk.karakter.pensioen.onder: Your knight gets a statue in the Rustende Ridders hall
vadsrijk.karakter.pensioen.iedereen: %s (%s) retires as a Rustende Ridder at level %s. A statue goes up in Zwamzoet!
vadsrijk.karakter.zaal.onder: They fainted once, and now rest in honour.
vadsrijk.karakter.optie: Characters: switch knight or make a new one
vadsrijk.karakter.tip.slots: You can have three knights: left Normal, middle Cuddle mode, right One-Vads. The ⚔ button next to your inventory!
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.vast: Every slot has a fixed game mode. It belongs to this knight and can never change.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.rust: Rests in the Rustende Ridders hall in Zwamzoet
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.welkom: Welcome to Het Vadsrijk! Choose how you want to play. You have three knights, each with a fixed game mode: left Normal, middle Cuddle mode, right One-Vads. Your own knight is ready on the left.
vadsrijk.karakter.scherm.uitleg_kort: Switch in a town or at a campfire. Clothes, mounts and pets are shared.
vadsrijk.karakter.knop.uitleg: Characters: your knights (switch or make a new one)
vadsrijk.karakter.fout.rust: That knight rests in the Rustende Ridders hall. Make a new One-Vads knight on the right!
vadsrijk.karakter.na_rust: You play on as %s. Your One-Vads knight now stands in the Rustende Ridders hall; you can make a new one on the right.
vadsrijk.karakter.welkom.chat: You can always find your knights: the ⚔ button left of your inventory, the Knights tab, shift + right-click a campfire, or talk to the Grootmeester, the Rekruteerder or a camp guard.
vadsrijk.karakter.tip.kampvuur: Shift + right-click a campfire to open your knights: switch or make a new one.
vadsrijk.karakter.optie.rekruteerder: Characters: what about those three knights?
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.8: Oh, one more thing! In Het Vadsrijk you may have three knights, each with a fixed way to play. Left Normal, in the middle Cuddle mode: monsters only hurt you half as much. And right One-Vads: one life, and if you faint, you get a statue!
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.9: A statue? And how do I choose?
vadsrijk.npc.werver.gesprek.10: After the welcome scene the screen opens by itself. Later you find your knights with the ⚔ button next to your inventory, with shift + right-click on a campfire, or at a camp guard. You can switch in a town or at a campfire. Vahoeg, recruit!
